Great Coffee
Jun 2026 • Couples
This is a cozy cafe that offers amazing food at a reasonable cost. It’s right at the heart of the city centre. We tried the chicken bowl, mushroom Panini , sweet milk coffee (cold) and incase you are a Kombucha lover they do have a varieties. We loved the apple ginger Kombucha. They also do have a lot of European options.
Incase you anre looking to book for a day cruise, they provide you a number to the service provider. We decided the day cruise just a day before and they helped us book the day cruise that is usually not seen on Klook. The ambience, food and the staff were all great!
